analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 43.1, while the MACD histogram continues to worsen from 21201.9648 to -3649.0840. The volume ratio compared to the 5-day average is 0.68, indicating contraction. ADX is at 23.8, entering the early stage of trend formation. The current price of 1,277,000 KRW is above the swing support of 1,246,000 KRW but below the swing resistance of 1,587,000 KRW. With an ATR of 110,301 KRW, setting a stop loss at 1.3x ATR and a target at 2.6x ATR may result in a risk-reward ratio below 1.5. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
